link.description:
Makes each task a link: `{path}` is the file's path under `path`,
e.g. `https://github.com/me/repo/blob/main/{path}`. Without it, a
task in progress links to its last pull request.

milestones.description: Open milestones shown as progress bars, active ones first.

path.description: The repository, or its `docs/planning` folder. `~/` is expanded.

planning.description: Also list tasks still in planning (`planning/*` states).
